goal: Finish AiDENs v0.1 as a build-certified, documentation-honest, agency-aware, receipt-bearing orchestration layer over canonical libraries.

issues.title: Run full cargo/script baseline and capture evidence
issues.why: All later claims need proof
issues.acceptance: cargo/check/test/clippy/verify logs captured; failures fixed or quarantined

issues.title: Rewrite root README into real project README
issues.why: Current README may be stale Codex-bundle prose
issues.acceptance: README has operator/developer quickstart, supported matrix, limitations

issues.title: Reconcile STATUS and issue matrices with actual code
issues.why: STATUS overclaim is the current main risk
issues.acceptance: No done/implemented claim without code+test proof

issues.title: Inventory every aidens-contracts public type
issues.why: Oversized contracts crate can become shadow truth
issues.acceptance: Ownership inventory complete; ambiguous types resolved

issues.title: Install deterministic P20 scanner into verify gate
issues.why: Grep-only checks are too weak
issues.acceptance: scanner runs in p20_verify and verify.sh or documented equivalent

issues.title: Lock provider capability matrix
issues.why: Provider truth must match executable support
issues.acceptance: mock/Ollama supported only if tested; cloud unavailable unless implemented

issues.title: Prove vertical slice with durable receipts
issues.why: No E2E path means no finish
issues.acceptance: tool turn test passes and records event log/receipts

issues.title: Add agency/influence policy crate or module
issues.why: New research requires first-class influence governance
issues.acceptance: agency artifacts + pre-generation gate + receipts exist

issues.title: Add influence/advice receipts
issues.why: Consequential influence without receipts is non-auditable
issues.acceptance: high-impact/memory/repeated-nudge receipts emitted

issues.title: Close deferred temporal reference behavior or demote docs
issues.why: Deferred interpreter contradicts done claims
issues.acceptance: no deferred reference for supported features

issues.title: Prove canonical memory adapter path
issues.why: AiDENs must delegate to semantic-memory lane
issues.acceptance: forge export -> bridge -> import -> query test exists

issues.title: Prove canonical kernel adapter path
issues.why: Kernel law belongs to canonical crates
issues.acceptance: compile/execute/oracle/witness path tested or docs demote

issues.title: Prove verification/governance adapter path
issues.why: Control decisions require receipts
issues.acceptance: adapter test + receipt proof

issues.title: Demote or prove repair record path
issues.why: Repair cannot stay folklore
issues.acceptance: repair tests or status demotion

issues.title: Harden JSON repair/treatment integrity
issues.why: Parser repair is semantic choke point
issues.acceptance: duplicate-key and treatment-changing repair tests pass

issues.title: Audit digest algorithm labels
issues.why: Mislabeling hash algorithm breaks evidence integrity
issues.acceptance: no hardcoded wrong digest prefixes

issues.title: Resolve scaffold crate fate
issues.why: Scaffolds cannot be product-ready
issues.acceptance: implemented, removed, or marked deferred

issues.title: Truthfully bound queue/schedule/wake support
issues.why: One-shot vs recurring semantics must be honest
issues.acceptance: queue/schedule docs and tests match implementation

issues.title: Update doctor/package audit outputs
issues.why: Operator UX must reflect real support
issues.acceptance: CLI reports supported/partial/deferred correctly

issues.title: Generate final audit bundle
issues.why: Release handoff needs artifacts
issues.acceptance: bundle exists and summarizes pass/fail
